note: Editable Fields provides one field formatter, editablefields_formatter ('Editable field'), made available for ALL field types via hook_field_formatter_info_alter(). It renders a field's edit widget inline or in a modal popup on the entity display so the value can be edited/saved without the full form. There is no configure route and no global settings page; all configuration is per-field in the display component's formatter settings (schema field.formatter.settings.editablefields_formatter) inside core.entity_view_display.<entity>.<bundle>.<mode>. Key settings: form_mode, behaviour (inline|popup), bypass_access, fallback_access/display_mode_access, fallback_edit/display_mode_edit, fields_ajax_trigger + fields_ajax_trigger_event (autosave). Access = 'use editablefields' permission AND entity update access (unless bypass_access). Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real formatter config on the Article view display.

evals.prompt: In Drupal, I want to let editors change a field's value directly on the node's display page instead of opening the full edit form. The Editable Fields module is enabled. What display formatter do I choose, and can it be used on any field type?
evals.expected_output: On the field's Manage display, set the formatter to 'Editable field' (editablefields_formatter). The module makes this formatter available for all field types via hook_field_formatter_info_alter(). It renders the field's edit widget on the display so it can be edited in place.

evals.prompt: With the Editable Fields formatter, how do I make a field open its edit widget in a modal popup instead of showing it inline? Which formatter setting controls that?
evals.expected_output: Set the formatter's 'behaviour' setting to 'popup' (the default is 'inline'). Popup renders an 'Edit' link that opens the widget in a modal dialog via the editablefields.get_from route; inline embeds the widget directly.

evals.prompt: Which permission must a Drupal user have to actually edit fields inline using the Editable Fields module, and what else is checked?
evals.expected_output: The user needs the 'use editablefields' permission AND update access to the entity (EditableFieldsHelper::checkAccess). If the formatter's bypass_access setting is TRUE, the update-access requirement is skipped.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a field configured with the Editable Fields formatter that opens its editor in a modal popup. Inspect the live default view display for Article and give the field's machine name and its behaviour setting.
evals.expected_output: field_ef_note, with behaviour 'popup': in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its component uses type editablefields_formatter and settings.behaviour: popup.

evals.prompt: One Article field on this site uses the Editable Fields formatter with autosave (it submits via ajax when the field changes, hiding the update button). Inspect the live view-display configuration and state which field it is and which DOM event triggers the autosave.
evals.expected_output: field_ef_auto, triggered on the 'blur' event: in core.entity_view_display.node.article.default its editablefields_formatter component has settings.fields_ajax_trigger: field_ef_auto and settings.fields_ajax_trigger_event: blur.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a text field field_ef_task currently shown with a plain string formatter in the default view display. Using the Editable Fields module, make this field editable inline on the display (embedded widget, not a popup). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_ef_task component's formatter to editablefields_formatter with settings.behaviour: inline (and a form_mode, e.g. default).

evals.prompt: On my Drupal site, I want editors to click an 'Edit' button next to the field_ef_pop field on an Article page and edit it in a popup dialog without leaving the page. The Editable Fields module is installed. Set field_ef_pop up to do that on the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_view_display.node.article.default set the field_ef_pop component's formatter to editablefields_formatter with settings.behaviour: popup (and a form_mode). This renders an 'Edit' link opening the widget in a modal dialog.
